title: Chump per-product brand tokens schema (EFFECTIVE-636 / EFFECTIVE-358 slice)
description: Design-token file for a single Chump-built product's brand palette. Follows the W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/) — each leaf token is an object with '$value' and '$type'; groups may carry a '$description'. Values map 1:1 onto the canonical CSS custom-property names enforced by docs/process/CSS_TOKEN_DISCIPLINE.md (INFRA-1590), so a product's brand tokens can be compiled straight into a ':root { }' block without renaming.

$description.description: Human-readable summary of what product/brand this token set belongs to.

product.description: Product slug this token set brands, e.g. 'chump-pwa', 'ribbon'. Used as the directory/file key when multiple products' tokens coexist.

color.description: Color token group. Keys are the canonical CSS custom-property names (minus the leading '--') from CSS_TOKEN_DISCIPLINE.md's canonical token list — do not introduce '*-primary' / '*-secondary' aliases here, per rule2-alias.

colorToken.description: A single W3C design-token leaf node of type 'color'.

$value.description: CSS color value: hex, rgb()/rgba(), or hsl()/hsla().

dimensionToken.description: A single W3C design-token leaf node of type 'dimension'.
